_about: Hand-authored glosses for the Nintendo EAD names the ROM's RTTI carries.
This is the one part of the class reference that is NOT derivable from the ROM.
tools/rtti_extract.py reads names and edges out of the binary and gates the result;
nothing in the binary says what 'Ukiyuka' means. That knowledge is here, hand-written,
and every entry carries a confidence so a reader can tell a settled Mario term from a
reading of a romaji fragment.
confidence:
high   - an established Mario-series Japanese name, or a common Japanese noun whose
reading is unambiguous AND corroborated by what the class demonstrably does
(its overlay's actor list in symbols/overlay_actors.md, or its own code).
medium - the reading is sound but the corroboration is indirect.
low    - a plausible reading offered so the next person has a starting point.
Treat as a question, not an answer.
Course codes are deliberately thin here. The code -> overlay -> level MAPPING is
derivable (tools/rtti_reference.py joins it from symbols/overlay_actors.md), so only
the etymology is recorded, and only where it is more than a guess.
Evidence beyond the actor lists: the ROM's own actor debug strings
(symbols/actor_debug_names.tsv, e.g. SPIDER, KERONPA_FIRE, CH_ROOM) and the stage and
model directory names in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin,
e.g. data/stage/kaizoku_irie, fire_land, desert_land). Those give most course codes
their etymology.
classes: a per-class override. tools/rtti_reference.py looks a part up here first, so
a part that means something else in one class (the Bk of daBttBk_c is 'block', not the
Battan King course) does not borrow the global reading.

f.note: fBase_c is the root of everything, including scenes and cameras, not just actors.

d.note: The bulk of the engine. dBase_c sits directly under fBase_c.

m.note: Only mHeap::Heap_t and its two children appear in this ROM's RTTI.

c.note: Seen only on the cMgSmartball_* family in ov006.

dExt.note: notes/model-rtti-names.md documents this family in full.

dM3dG.note: dM3dGLin is a line, dM3dGSph a sphere; both are bases of dBgCh_* queries.

Bk.note: ov015, whose actor list is entirely WF.

Wl.note: DDD's Japanese name is Water Land; ov026 carries SUBMARINE, WHIRLPOOL, WATER_SUCTION.

Ki.gloss: Kaizoku Irie (pirate cove) -- Jolly Roger Bay
Ki.note: Stage dir data/stage/kaizoku_irie in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin); its sibling kaizoku_ship is Ks. ov016: SHIP_UP/DOWN, ROCK_PILLAR, UNAGI.

Fl.note: Stage dir data/stage/fire_land in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin); the volcano interior is fire_mt (Fm). ov022 is entirely LLL.

Wc.note: Stage dir data/stage/water_city in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin); mapping from ov029.

Dl.gloss: Desert Land -- Shifting Sand Land (the outdoor desert)
Dl.note: Stage dir data/stage/desert_land in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin). ov024: PYRAMID_TOP, PYRAMID_TAG -- the pyramid seen from outside; its interior is Dp.

Dp.gloss: Desert Pyramid -- Shifting Sand Land (pyramid interior)
Dp.note: Stage dir data/stage/desert_py in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin). ov025: PYRAMID_STEP, PYRAMID_LIFT, GRINDEL.

Hm.note: Stage dir data/stage/high_mt in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin); ov030 carries HM_BASKET and HM_MARUTA.

Rc.note: Stage dir data/stage/rainbow_cruise in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin).

Ct.note: Stage dir data/stage/clock_tower in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin); every CT_MECHA* model is special_obj/ct_mecha_objNN.

Km.gloss: Koopa Map -- a Bowser stage (Km1/Km2/Km3 are the three)
Km.note: Stage dirs data/stage/koopa1_map..koopa3_map in the ROM file-name table (extracted/overlays/overlay_0000.bin); the boss arenas are koopaN_boss (Kb). ov043/ov045/ov047 carry the three courses' furniture.

Mc.note: ROM stage dir data/stage/main_castle; ov009 carries MC_WATER = CASTLE_WATER (moat), MC_METALNET, MC_FLAG, SBIRD (include/daObjMcWater_c.h:1).

C0.note: Stage dir data/stage/castle_b1; C0_WATER = BASEMENT_WATER, C0_SWITCH = SWITCH_PILLAR (ov012). The splitter currently cuts this as C + 0.

C1.note: Stage dir data/stage/castle_1f; C1_PEACH = PEACH_PAINTING, C1_HIKARI = LIGHT_BEAM, C1_TRAP = TRAP (ov010). C2 (castle_2f) shows up in the file table as c2_huriko / c2_hari_* but not in RTTI.

Sm.note: Stage dir data/stage/snow_mt; SM_LIFT(63) = SKI_LIFT, ov018 (include/daObjSm_Lift_c.h:7).

Ks.gloss: Kaizoku Ship -- the sunken pirate ship in Jolly Roger Bay
Ks.note: Stage dir data/stage/kaizoku_ship; KS_MIZU(62) = SHIP_WATER, ov017 (include/daObjKsWater_c.h:1).

Th.note: Stage dir data/stage/teresa_house; TH_DOWN_B(66) = FALL_BLOCK_BBH, ov063; the file table also has th_hondana, th_kaidan, th_mery_go, th_trap. NOT the Th of dThIcon_c (touch).

Hs.gloss: High Slider -- the Princess's Secret Slide
Hs.note: Stage dir data/stage/high_slider; HS_MOON / HS_STAR / HS_Y_STAR / HS_B_STAR (302-305) are the ov031 slide decorations (include/daObjHsBillboard_c.h:1). Caveat: HS_UPDOWN_LIFT(30) is labelled ROTATING_UP_DOWN_PLATFORM_UTM, which does not obviously belong to the slide.

Td.note: Stage dir data/stage/tibi_deka_d; TD_FUTA(106) = HUGE_COVER, TD_WATER(107) = HUGE_WATER (ov032). tibi (tiny) / deka (huge) is THI's Japanese name.

Tt.note: Stage dir data/stage/tibi_deka_t; TT_FUTA(104) = TINY_COVER, TT_WATER(105) = TINY_WATER (ov033).

Kb.gloss: Koopa Boss -- a Bowser battle arena (Kb1/Kb2/Kb3)
Kb.note: Stage dirs data/stage/koopa1_boss..koopa3_boss; the file table has kb1_ball, kb2_stage, kb3_stage. KB1_BILLBOARD(301) = ORANGE_BALL_BILLBOARD, ov044 (include/daObjKb1Billboard_c.h:1). Mirrors Km = koopaN_map.

Emm.gloss: Ex Mario map -- an extra (secret) stage
Emm.note: Stage dir data/stage/ex_m_map, alongside ex_mario, ex_l_map / ex_luigi, ex_w_map / ex_wario. EMM_LOG(174), EMM_YUKA(175) in ov052. Which in-game stage this is was not confirmed.

Ewm.gloss: Ex Wario map -- an extra (secret) stage
Ewm.note: Stage dir data/stage/ex_w_map; EWM_ICE_BLOCK(173) = BIG_MOVING_ICE_BLOCK, ov056; file special_obj/ewm_ice_brock.

Ewb.gloss: Ex Wario boss? -- Chief Chilly's arena
Ewb.note: EWB_ICE_A/B/C (170-172) = CCC_ARENA / BIG_ICE / SMALL_ICE, ov073, alongside KING_DONKETU (Chief Chilly). E + w follows the ex_w_* pattern; reading b as boss follows Kb = koopaN_boss. There is no ex_w_boss dir (only ex_wario), so the b is a guess.

Fm.gloss: Fire Mountain -- inside Lethal Lava Land's volcano
Fm.note: The only matching stage dir is data/stage/fire_mt (next to fire_land = Fl). FM_BATTAN(84) = SQUASHER is ov023's only actor. Conflicts with include/daObjFm_Battan_c.h:3, which calls it Shifting Sand Land's squasher without citing evidence.

Dsn.note: daDsn_c is the tree's Thwomp; daDsnBase_c is its base.

Donketu.note: daIDonketu_c is the Ice Bully (Chill Bully) in ov027.

Kirai.note: daKirai_c sits in ov060 with the Bowser fight.

Maruta.note: daObjMaruta_c is the base of FallBlockLll (rolling log) and daObjHmBskt_c.

Kumo.note: Could also be spider, but 'cloud' fits daObjKumo_c's platform role and is now doubly corroborated: ACTOR_DEBUG_NAMES index 314 is the literal ROM string OBJ_KUMO, and symbols/overlay_actors.md independently glosses the same index CLOUD(314). Bumped medium -> high.

Mip.gloss: Mip -- a proper name, not a common noun. The community-facing translation is 'Rabbit', but the ROM's own RTTI (daMip_c, ov085) and ACTOR_DEBUG_NAMES index 187 (literal string MIP) agree on the Nintendo-internal name.
Mip.note: Corroborated three ways at index 187: ACTOR_DEBUG_NAMES string MIP, RTTI class daMip_c (ov085), and symbols/overlay_actors.md's RABBIT(187). The paired key item, daObj_Mip_Key_c (ov085), matches ACTOR_DEBUG_NAMES index 229 (OBJ_MIP_KEY) against overlay_actors.md's RABBIT_KEY(229) the same way.

Tikuwa.gloss: chikuwa -- a tube-shaped food; a ring/tube platform

Dorifu.note: Reading unconfirmed. daObjDorifu_c's own code steps a 0..4 index over five dBgW_Kc subobjects, enabling one at a time (include/daObjDorifu_c.h). The debug strings fit a staircase better than a drifting platform: KM1_DORIFU = STAIRS_BDW, KM3_DORIFU = STAIRS_BS, RC_DORIFU = TRICKY_TRIANGLES, and the file table has km3_dan0..4 (dan = step) -- a staircase that raises one step at a time.

Ots.note: daOts_c is the proven base of daDonketu_c and daBDonketu_c. No reading offered.

Demo.note: Standard Nintendo dev usage; daDemo_c carries anmModel_c and simpleModel_c inner classes.

Smartball.note: cMgSmartball_* is a 12-class family in ov006 (pakkun, dokan, kinoko, spring, slot, ...).

Sph.note: dM3dGSph is the sphere primitive; dBgCh_SphCrr is the tree's dBgCh_SphCrr.

Lin.note: dM3dGLin is the line primitive; dBgCh_Lin is the tree's dBgCh_Lin.

Dfdr.note: daPgDfdr_c = PENGUIN_DEFENDER(258) (include/daPgDfdr_c.h:1-3); overlay_actors.md calls it BRIDGE_PENGUIN -- the penguin that blocks the bridge.

Bth.note: daSnmBth_c = SNOWMAN_BREATH(275), ov027; include/daSnmBth_c.h:1 (one collision-bearing breath particle).

Snowman.note: The English is misleading: daSnowman_c = debug string SNOWMAN(223) = MR_BLIZZARD in overlay_actors.md ov081 (files snowman/snowman_model.bmd, snow_ball.bmd). The big snowman is daBgSnwmn_c.

Tor.note: daTor_c = TORNADO(308), ov096; model dir data/enemy/sand_tornado; commit 67752d9092 (was Tornado).

Ibl.note: daIbl_c = IRONBALL(220) = ROLLING_IRON_BALL, ov100; rtti_reconcile coined name RollingIronBall.

Wbm.note: daWbm_c = WATERBOMB(208), ov098; include/daWbm_c.h:1 (the tree called it WaterBomb); dir data/enemy/water_bomb.

Bombhei.note: daRedBombhei_c = RED_BOMBHEI(181) = BOB_OMB_BUDDY (the red Bob-omb); files bombhei/red_bombhei.bmd. Standard Mario name.

Bombking.note: daBombking_c = BOMBKING(189) = KING_BOB_OMB, ov078; file bombking/bomb_king.bmd.

Shell.note: Misleading English: daObjShell_c = OBJ_SHELL(315) = CLAM in overlay_actors.md ov064 (dir normal_obj/obj_shell). The Koopa shell is daShl_c.

Brq.note: daBrq_c = BIRIKYU(266) = AMP, ov070; dir data/enemy/birikyu. Brq is the consonant skeleton of biri-kyu.

Krpa.note: daKrpa_c = KERONPA(270) = FLAME_CHOMP, ov070; include/daKrpa_c.h:1 (the tree once coined FlameChomp); dir data/enemy/keronpa.

Kp.note: In daKpFr_c, Kp is short for Keronpa: the debug string is KERONPA_FIRE(271) = FLAME_CHOMP_FIRE, ov070, next to KERONPA. Do not read it as Kpa/Koopa.

Eykn.note: daEykn_c = EYEKUN(262) / EYEKUN_BOSS(263) = MR_I / BIG_MR_I, ov071; include/daEykn_c.h:1; dir data/enemy/eyekun.

Jgm.note: daJgm_c = JUGEM(265) = LAKITU, ov077 (the Spiny-throwing Lakitu); dir data/enemy/jugem. Same word as the existing Jugem term.

Tgz.note: daTgz_c = TOGEZO(260) = SPINY, ov077; include/daTgz_c.h:1; dir data/enemy/togezo.

Popoi.note: daPopoi_c = POPOI(238) = HEAVE_HO, ov077; dir data/enemy/popoi.

Holhei.note: daHolhei_c = HOLHEI(190) = CHUCKYA, ov062; include/daHolhei_c.h:1; the model dir spells it horuhei.

Jango.note: daJango_c = JANGO(239) = KLEPTO, ov062; dir data/enemy/jango.

Huwa.note: daHuwa_c = HUWAHUWA(312) = SPINDRIFT, ov081; include/daHuwa_c.h (Spindrift_Spawn). huwahuwa = fluffy / floaty.

Hyuhyu.note: daHyuhyu_c = HYUHYU(231) = FWOOSH, ov091; include/daHyuhyu_c.h:1; commit deef65a62a (was Fwoosh).

Onms.note: daOnms_c = ONIMASU(309) = TOX_BOX, ov092; include/daOnms_c.h:1; dir data/enemy/onimasu.

Dgr.note: daDgr_c = DONGURU(163) = SPINDEL; include/daDgr_c.h:1; dir data/enemy/donguru.

Dkk.note: daDkk_c = DONKAKU(162) = GRINDEL, ov025; dir data/enemy/donkaku. Its base is daDsnBase_c (include/daDkk_c.h), which fits a Thwomp relative.

Btn.note: daBtn_c = BATAN(164) / BATANKING(165) = WHOMP / WHOMP_KING, ov079; commit c87a04846a (was Whomp).

Battan.gloss: Battan -- Whomp; here a slamming squasher
Battan.note: FM_BATTAN(84) = SQUASHER, the only actor in ov023; dir special_obj/fm_battan. Battan is Whomp's Japanese name (data/enemy/battan, battan_king); the object is a Whomp-like slab that slams down.

Btt.note: daBttBk_c = BATTA_BLOCK(193) = CRAZED_CRATE, ov080; dir data/enemy/batta_block. The hopping crate. Its Bk is block, not the Bk course.

Choro.note: daChoro_Rock_c = CHORO_ROCK(311) = MONTY_MOLE_ROCK; file choropu/rock.bmd; rtti_reconcile coined MontyMoleRock.

Iwante.note: daIwante_c = IWANTE(176) = EYEROK, ov066; files iwante_lhand/iwante_rhand.bmd; rtti_reconcile coined Eyerok. iwa (rock) + te (hand).

Grock.note: daGrock_c = GORO_ROCK(221) = ROLLING_ROCK, ov021; dir special_obj/cv_goro_rock. goro(goro) is the sound of rolling.

Nknk.note: daNknk_c = NOKONOKO(203) / NOKONOKO_S(204) = KOOPA / KOOPA_SMALL, ov062; rtti_reconcile coined Koopa; dir data/enemy/nokonoko.

Mky.note: daMky_c = MONKEY_THIEF(267) / MONKEY_STAR(268) = UKIKI_THIEF / UKIKI_STAR, ov030; dir data/enemy/monkey.

Bakubaku.note: daBakubaku_c = BAKUBAKU(228) = BUBBA; dir data/enemy/bakubaku. bakubaku = munch munch.

Mucho.gloss: second half of Snufit's Japanese name (Yurei Mucho)
Mucho.note: Proper-name fragment; YUREI_MUCHO(236) = SNUFIT. No separate meaning offered for Mucho.

Kuri.note: daKuriKing_c = KURIKING(198) = GOOMBOSS, ov074; rtti_reconcile coined Goomboss; dir data/enemy/kuriking. Same root as the existing Krb term.

Teresa.note: dScMgTeresa_c = MG_TERESA(387) = MG_HIDE_AND_BOO_SEEK. The same word the existing Trs term abbreviates.

Koopa.note: In EAD usage Koopa is Bowser: KOOPA(279) = BOWSER, WL_KOOPA_SHUTTER(91) = BOWSER_SHUTTER (commit 49e7449f63 renamed BowserShutter to daObjWlKoopaShutter_c). A Koopa Troopa is Nokonoko.

Koma.note: FL_KOMA_D(80) = ROTATING_PLATFORM_LLL, FL_KOMA_U(81) = ROTATING_FIREBAR; include/daObjFl_Koma_D_c.h:1 (a spinning disc derived from daObjKaitendai_c).

Gura.note: FL_GURA(72) = TILTING_PLATFORM_LLL, KM2_GURA(141) = TILTING_PLATFORM_BFS; include/daObjFl_Gura_c.h: its storage is filled by the base daObjGuragura_c.

London.gloss: London Bridge -- a collapsing lava bridge
London.note: FL_LONDON(73) = LAVA_BRIDGE, ov022 (include/daObjFl_London_c.h:1). Read as the nursery rhyme 'London Bridge is falling down'. Inferred from the object, not documented anywhere.

Uki.note: FL_UKI_KI(82) = LAVA_PLANK, a bobbing plank (include/daObjFl_UkiKi_c.h:1); dir special_obj/fl_uki_ki next to fl_uki_yuka. The Ki that follows is ki (wood), not the Ki course.

Amilift.note: ami (net) + lift. FL_AMILIFT(69) = METAL_NET_LIFT; rtti_reconcile coined MetalNetLift.

Dossunbar.gloss: Thwomp bar -- a sliding bar that slams
Dossunbar.note: dossun (Thwomp / thud) + bar. BK_DOSSUNBAR_L/S(53/54) = MOVING_BAR_BIG/SMALL, ov015; include/daObjBk_Dossunbar_c.h:1.

Rotebar.note: BK_ROTEBAR(51) = ROTATING_BRIDGE, ov015; include/daObjBk_Rotebar_c.h: turns by half-turns with pauses.

Killerdai.note: killer (Bullet Bill) + dai (stand). BK_KILLER_DAI(43) = BILL_BLASTER, ov079; include/daObjBkKillerdai_c.h:1.

Swdoor.note: include/daObjSwdoor_c.h:1-2: 'swdoor is switch door, the ROM's own contraction'. daObjBSwdoor_c = SWITCHDOOR(40) = SHUTTER_BOB.

Udlift.note: daUdlift_c = UDLIFT(33) / UDLIFT_TERESA(32) = UP_DOWN_LIFT_HMC / UP_DOWN_LIFT_BBH; dir normal_obj/obj_updnlift.

Guruguru.gloss: round and round -- a spinning platform

Mecha.gloss: mechanism -- a clockwork piece of Tick Tock Clock
Mecha.note: Every Mecha class is a CT_MECHA0N debug string (108-122: TTC conveyor belts, moving bars, cubes, beam, cogs, clock hand) with model dir special_obj/ct_mecha_objNN. The number is EAD's part index; decompose() strips it.

Brock.note: DP_BROCK(87) = PYRAMID_STEP (include/daObjDpBrock_c.h:1). The ROM spells block as brock elsewhere too: special_obj/ewm_ice_brock, special_obj/sl_ice_brock.

Kinoko.note: KINOKO_TAG(320) / KINOKO_CREATE_TAG(319) = MEGA_MUSHROOM_TAG / _CREATE_TAG; ONEUPKINOKO(276) and SCALEUP_KINOKO(277) are da1up_c; dir normal_obj/scale_up_kinoko. The case-insensitive lookup also covers cMgSmartball_kinoko_c.

Hatena.note: HATENA_BLOCK(20) = QUESTION_BLOCK, HATENA_SWITCH(26) = QUESTION_SWITCH; commit 7d5ecfe955 renamed QuestionBlock to daObjHatenaBlock_c.

Warpkun.note: daWarpkun_c = WARPKUN(347) = WARP, ov002. -kun is the familiar name suffix.

Cre.note: daSCre_c = STAR_CREATE(355) = POWER_STAR_CREATE, ov018; include/daSCre_c.h:1 (star-create trigger).

Gen.note: daBookGen_c = BOOK_GENERATOR(328) = BOOK_SHOT_SPAWNER; rtti_reconcile coined BookShotSpawner.

Bskt.note: daObjHmBskt_c = HM_BASKET(103) = UKIKI_CAGE, ov030; dir special_obj/hm_basket.

Ent.note: dEntObj_c = ENTRY_OBJECT(346), ov075, next to ENTRY(6) / RESULT(7) (dScEntry_c). rtti_reconcile coined UnknownVsEntry.

News.gloss: N-E-W-S? (a lift moving in compass directions)
News.note: CV_NEWS_LIFT(68) = WORK_ELEVATOR in Hazy Maze Cave (commit e4e674a324, was WorkElevator). Reading it as North-East-West-South from a lift that moves in compass directions is a guess; not checked against daObjCvNewsLift_c's code.

Bar.note: Misleading English: daBar_c = BAR(287) = INVISIBLE_POLE, ov002.

Pile.note: daObjPile_c = PILE(27) = STUMP, ov091; dir normal_obj/obj_pile. Pile in the driven-post sense, not a heap.

Linelift2.gloss: line lift -- a lift that follows a path line

Gnd.note: dBgCh_Gnd is one of the dBgCh_* terrain queries; the reading is the usual abbreviation. Its header is auto-generated and names no role.

Pos.note: include/dCcPos_c.h:1 'A cylinder that carries its own position'; dCcAcPos_c 'keeps its own position'.

Crr.note: dBgCh_SphCrr is the sphere terrain query; Crr read as 'correct'. The header is auto-generated and documents no role.

Bk.note: BATTA_BLOCK(193) = CRAZED_CRATE (symbols/actor_debug_names.tsv); not the Battan King course code.

Ki.note: FL_UKI_KI(82) = LAVA_PLANK; dir special_obj/fl_uki_ki. uki (floating) + ki (wood), not the Jolly Roger Bay course code.

Ch.note: CH_ROOM(348) = VIRTUAL_DOOR, an area-transition trigger box (include/daChRoom_c.h:1). Not the Ch of the dBgCh_* collision queries.
CH_SCENE(349) = EXIT, the scene-transition sibling of daChRoom_c. Not the Ch of the dBgCh_* collision queries.

Th.note: dThIcon_c is the touch-screen icon base; dMgPsOpt_c::TouchIcon_c derives from it (include/dMgPsOpt_c.h:11). Not the Teresa House course code.
